prompt: Dehydration of 2-butanol with H₂SO₄, heat. Draw the MAJOR alkene product.

traps.note: Zaitsev favors the more substituted alkene (2-butene over 1-butene).

explanation: Acid dehydration proceeds through a 2° carbocation; β-H elimination gives the more substituted (and thermodynamically stable) 2-butene as the major product.
